description: Returns the lunar and solar eclipses of a calendar year with their type, the time of greatest eclipse in a time zone, the contact times of lunar eclipses, where solar eclipses are greatest and which of 16 major world cities see each one. The type filter limits the list to lunar or solar eclipses.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone name such as America/New_York or Asia/Tokyo; UTC when omitted.

type.description: Limits the list to lunar or to solar eclipses; both when omitted.

year.description: Calendar year from 1900 to 2100; the current year when omitted.

name: list_eclipses
title: Eclipses of a year
